ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: weighted_logsigmoid_advantage_scaled
ir.intuition: Repaired to avoid softplus which caused high similarity to existing losses. This loss uses the log-sigmoid of the score difference to provide a smooth and stable penalty, weighted by the advantage gap magnitudes clamped between 0 and 5 to limit outlier influence, and multiplied by sample weight. This reduces similarity by changing the link function and adding advantage clamping, emphasizes confident pairs while controlling scale, and maintains smooth gradients.
ir.pseudocode:
adv_clamped = clamp(abs(advantage_gap), 0, 5)
score_diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
loss = -logsigmoid(score_diff) * adv_clamped * weight
final_loss = mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    adv_clamped = ops.clamp(ops.abs(adv_gap), 0, 5)
    score_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    loss_raw = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(score_diff))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(ops.mul(loss_raw, adv_clamped), weight)
    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)
